title: Backup and recovery operations: proposal, installation, service and independent receiving

task.name: Commission the complete recovery operating workspace and customer handover
task.purpose: Give the implementation team and operating staff one maintained workspace for complete proposal assumptions, actual protected inventory, recovery dependencies, provider job records, restore observations, incident follow-through and customer review. Preserve every source edition and continue the same operating history through managed browser access, agent calls, complete exports and independent receiving.
task.request: Continue the original customer Workshare and Installation. Receive the complete selected proposal, its full response register and acceptance programme. Measure and retain the actual installation inputs, agree the protected workloads and recovery targets, import whole provider files through explicit mappings, operate recovery and correction workflows, review the exact accepted versions, establish recurring restore and incident procedures, and independently receive the complete application and saved workspace. Record actual customer receiving observations in the existing Installation.
task.completeOutput: Complete selected proposal and assumptions; all retained source bytes and mappings; original plan editions, dependencies and recorded plan decisions; full backup/recovery/incident/hurricane histories with corrections; operational acceptance and continuing schedules; complete service-period review; usable managed browser and agent access; independently editable received branches; all application source, operating materials and actual receiving results.
task.repeatTrigger: A new proposal edition, changed inventory or approved plan, complete provider export, recovery exercise, corrected observation, incident, hurricane trigger, service period or handover continues the original workspace. Resume an interrupted request from its saved full command and result. Record a genuinely later observation as a new command rather than changing the earlier event.
task.pricedUnit: Use the original commercial plan and its expressly selected implementation or recurring-service scope. Keep proposal engineering, deployment, product subscriptions, storage, retrieval, egress, onsite work, exercises and continuing support as separately agreed items. Retain native atomic-unit prices and existing funding/payment selections when the Customer workflow uses them.

source.reference: Original customer proposal and complete issued-source response register; authorized inventory, protected scope, supplier quotes and measurement files; selected provider exports; recovery observations and customer decisions; incident and communication records. The included public MPC planning source is retained at its original edition.
source.population: Receive every selected proposal response and acceptance step, every original source file and every row in the selected provider export. The current proposal includes 64 response items and 12 acceptance steps. The operating model permits 8 MiB per source, 32 MiB of distinct retained sources, 5,000 commands and 96 MiB for the complete canonical workspace including retained history. Select a full intended installation population that fits these declared limits; retain the previous whole workspace if a requested addition exceeds them.
source.meaning: Keep declared planning assumptions, actual observed inventory, proposed targets, recorded approval, measured results and later corrections distinct. Source bytes, media type, encoding, SHA-256 and exact line/JSON references stay attached to their observations. Sizes are bytes in the operating model; RPO/RTO are minutes and recurring intervals are days. All event timestamps require seconds and an explicit timezone. Preserve null where a fact has not been recorded.
source.changePolicy: Save each plan as a complete immutable edition linked to its predecessor. Correct an observation by recording the full replacement, reason and expected current record hash. Keep earlier source files, original operations and first results. Acceptance remains attached to the exact recovery version selected by its reviewer; a later correction requires a later review. A received portable workspace creates its own local branch while preserving the existing branch.

receiving.application: Use Applications kind and product mpc-recovery-operations, with the complete original application under products/mpc-recovery-operations/app/. Settings are workspaceDirectory, optional connectionFile and optional port. The maintained Runtime owns its Node 20+ process; the persistent store uses the existing flock helper. MpcRecoveryClient/createMpcRecoveryClient and merchant_mpc_recovery_ tools use the same service, configured through mpcRecovery/mpcRecoveryConnection. Each physical store has its own UUID and canonical directory, distinct from the original portable workspace IDs held in its branches. Select a separate complete receiving output directory for the receiving course.
receiving.acceptanceRule: Operate all nine original application sections with the complete selected proposal and actual source files. Save and reopen a plan edition; exercise explicit provider mapping, original command retry and conflicting edit handling; review complete results and all retained versions. Receive the full workspace into another independent branch, make a legitimate later change, reopen both branches, and verify that receiving an earlier edition preserves the later branch. Download the complete application and handover, open the actual downloaded application independently, and inspect the desktop and 390-pixel layouts. Record the observed result in the original Installation.
receiving.changeAndWithdraw: The customer retains its selected accounts, data access, backup administration, export and transfer responsibilities. Keep private service connection capabilities in their designated configuration. Source retention, access withdrawal, end-of-contract transfer and deletion follow the named customer and provider owners. Attach each actual operational completion to the corresponding retained source and decision.
receiving.recovery: Retain both portable workspace identity and the selected local branch. Preserve an unsaved form before reviewing a conflict. Reuse a saved command ID only with its exact original body; select a new ID for a later business decision. Reopen and validate the complete saved snapshot and operation chain. Preserve the original accepted native archive and continue any existing receiving operation from its retained state instead of repeating completed business actions.
receiving.maintenance: Review automated provider exceptions, agreed backup and restore cadence, recurring recovery due dates, incident communications and the full service period through the same saved workspace. Record changed inventory or targets as a new plan edition. Keep the original application source selection, runtime requirements and complete export procedure with the installation. Maintain original customer support and prime-provider ownership.

steps.title: Continue the customer installation and original proposal
steps.result: Open the existing Workshare, commercial plan and Installation. Retain original phase, funding, payment and effort selections. Receive the complete selected proposal, all response decisions and twelve acceptance steps; retain each later proposal edition separately.

steps.title: Establish complete source and inventory custody
steps.result: Retain the authorized installation inventory, provider records, supplier quotes and original measurement files. Identify every protected workload, owner and repository from the actual source. Preserve full source bytes and exact references.

steps.title: Measure and revise capacity and transfer assumptions
steps.result: Open the unchanged proposal planner with the complete selected case. Record actual changed-data, storage, network and operating-window inputs, whole-case calculations, missing quote lines and the complete four-year schedule. Save and receive its new edition.

steps.title: Save the installation design and its decision
steps.result: Create the complete local/offsite repository and workload plan. Review dependency order, proposed RPO/RTO and restore intervals; save the immutable edition. Record the named approval decision for that exact plan.

steps.title: Install managed browser and agent access
steps.result: Create or select the actual persistent workspace; bind the maintained Application and private connection; open the original operating interface and agent client against the same saved branches. Retain operator identity, connection location and full receiving destination.

steps.title: Receive actual provider observations
steps.result: Import the complete CSV, TSV or JSON file and retain its mapping of identity, status, recovery point, completion, verification, bytes and timezone. Review every mapped record before committing; retain failed, partial and running observations with their original meaning.

steps.title: Record recoveries and explicit corrections
steps.result: Select the exact saved plan and backup version when applicable. Record the actual recovery point, incident reference, start, service-ready time, method and verification. Compare measured RPO/RTO to the selected targets. Append corrections with the prior version hash and reason.

steps.title: Review acceptance and establish recurring restores
steps.result: Review exact recovery versions and retain their acceptance decisions. Record monitoring, reporting, administrative access, training and deficiency findings. Establish recurring schedules from the selected plan and review the full due list.

steps.title: Operate incidents and hurricane preparation
steps.result: Record actual operational triggers, impact/incident times and observed job coverage. Retain completed email, telephone and status communications with source references. Follow the displayed timing and record restoration and the written incident report against the selected incident version.

steps.title: Review the complete service period
steps.result: Select explicit from/to/as-of timestamps. Review all backup statuses, recovery observations, target comparisons, due items, acceptance gaps, incident communications and retained corrections. Export the complete report and original workspace.

steps.title: Independently receive and continue the full delivery
steps.result: Download the complete handover and application. Receive the exact workspace into a distinct branch and the actual downloaded application in a fresh browser context. Save a later edition, reopen it, recover both branches and preserve stale forms when another session saves first.

steps.title: Record customer receiving and continuing ownership
steps.result: Retain the actual desktop/mobile observations, complete saved outputs and receiving result in the original Installation. Confirm operating contacts, continuing restore/service schedule, full export and account transfer procedures, and ownership of remaining customer implementation work.

inputs: Original customer case, complete commercial plan, Workshare and current Installation with original phase, funding, effort and payment selections.
Complete saved proposal case, its original response register and acceptance programme, source editions and actual supplier quote inputs.
Original selected solicitation and addenda or the customer's equivalent complete requirements and operating decisions.
Authorized actual inventory, owners, protected scope, repository locations, provider identities and complete dependency information.
Measured storage, changed data, network throughput, backup windows and retention inputs with units, timestamps and original files.
Agreed recovery targets and restore intervals, exact plan edition, named actor and approval source.
Actual persistent workspace directory and UUID, maintained Runtime with Node 20+ and flock, optional private connectionFile/loopback port and a separate complete receiving output directory.
Whole CSV, TSV or JSON provider exports with explicit identity, status, timezone, size and recovery-point mappings.
Actual backup completion, recovery points, verification times, partial/failed results and correcting source evidence.
Actual recovery method, selected immutable backup version, incident reference, start, usable-service time and verification.
Customer acceptance sources, exact reviewed recovery versions, operational criterion findings and recurring restore schedules.
Actual hurricane trigger/receipt/impact observations, protected scope and complete local/offsite job coverage.
Actual incident and restoration records, completed dual-channel notifications, status updates and written resolution report.
Explicit service-period and review-clock timestamps with timezone; complete selected workspace and report outputs.
Original accepted native archive and receiving operation where one already exists, complete source selection and following branch exports.
Named operating, support, account transfer, customer receiving and data-retention owners.
